effect: Decisions take effect only when the containing change is accepted on canonical main; archives are historical evidence, never law.

entries.title: Harden warning gates for generated-source builds
entries.reason: Scope build flags using actual source ownership and preserve visible inherited warnings and the existing protected warning policy.

entries.title: Require lifecycle proof for stacked resource overrides
entries.reason: Verify resolver order, earlier-phase side effects, baseline, initial load and reload, rather than relying on final overlay state.

entries.title: docs: require evidence for streaming discontinuities
entries.reason: Require clock/transition ownership, stateful-consumer re-entry, independent output evidence and transition callback cost.

entries.title: Keep a human approval from closing a trial gate
entries.reason: Keep named human approval and observed trial evidence distinct in both directions.

entries.title: Require evidence of each named acceptance action.
entries.reason: Require evidence for every named action and observable result; sibling-path log tokens cannot close the action gate.

entries.title: Add TEST-CULL-001: shared GPU pipeline winding coverage.
entries.reason: Generalize candidate TEST-CULL-001 into the existing testing home: test every shipped producer sharing a culling pipeline with the same independent outward-winding oracle.

entries.title: Add TEST-PAYLOAD-001: measure named payload, not index RSS.
entries.reason: Generalize candidate TEST-PAYLOAD-001 into the existing testing home: measure actual production payload bytes, distinguish index/RSS and round-trip the declared cell count.

entries.title: Add TEST-SAMPLE-001: measure sampling span in the contract's units.
entries.reason: Generalize candidate TEST-SAMPLE-001 into the existing testing home: verify the authored span and stable UVs on shipped mesh/shader inputs in contract units.

entries.title: Require a fetched base tip before calling a pull request current.
entries.reason: Fetch and record base/head ahead-behind state, preserve shared history and check combined integration before recommendations or authorized merge.

entries.title: Headless worker baseline and completion evidence
entries.reason: Port only generic baseline/delta, terminal-result and immutable candidate review requirements; original private worktree remains unchanged.

entries.title: Foreign-session freeze variant 1
entries.reason: Superseded by the later local variant and current source-trust rules; tool identity alone must not restart an ongoing invocation or replace its freeze.

entries.title: Foreign-session freeze variant 2
entries.reason: Current rules already resolve accepted source at a genuine top-level call and treat retrieved sessions as evidence. Automatic foreign-tool invocation restart is not adopted; actual continuity and director instructions govern.

entries.title: Preserve complete files during narrow corrections
entries.reason: Port the generic excerpt/deletion-preservation contract, allow explicitly authorized deletion, and preserve original private staged files and index.

entries.title: Interactive entry drives shipped core
entries.reason: Closure record and current law confirm the actual renderer/server/GameTest production-entry safeguard was already incorporated.

entries.title: One-level local pack resolver
entries.reason: The unified GitHub snapshot supersedes sibling-walk pack discovery; restoring this workflow would revive retired ambiguity.

entries.title: Separate skill and binding-pack roots
entries.reason: Skill and binding law now share one verified snapshot. The former PACK_ROOT split is retired.

entries.title: Lifecycle hooks and intrusive diagnostics
entries.reason: Closure points to accepted PR 13; current law retains exact lifecycle, least-intrusive capture, capture approval and privacy safeguards.
